app.title: Dream Book
onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.intro: A few settings, then we begin. Everything stays on this device.
onboarding.role.help: The Dreamer works on their own dream. The Dream Friend runs the meetings. "Both" is for a peer pair that alternates the role.
onboarding.config: How we go through the course
onboarding.config.help: Picks which variant of the pair exercises shows first. The others stay one tap away.
onboarding.paper: I keep my dream list on paper
onboarding.paper.help: The paper Dream Book is the primary medium. The app never nags you to transcribe; it keeps only the chosen dream and the count.
home.plans.none: No active plan. Every module ends with one.
home.chosen: The dream I am working on
home.chosen.none: No dream chosen yet. You choose it in module 2.
home.friendMode: Today I am the Dream Friend
home.friendMode.help: Switches the pair-exercise text to the Friend seat and shows the Friend section.
modules.title: Modules
modules.locked.none: Modules are not locked. The order below is the suggested one.
module.next.plan: Write it as a plan: if [situation], then [action]
module.next.saved: Plan saved. You can see it on Home.
module.takeaways.mine: What I take with me (in my words)
module.contentFallback: Course content is in Romanian; the interface can be in English.
dreams.title: The 100 dreams list
dreams.add.placeholder: A dream, however small or big…
dreams.paper: You keep the list on paper. Here you note only the count and, from module 2, the chosen dream.
dreams.paper.count: How many dreams are in your book?
dreams.tag.help: From inside: growth, relationships, contribution, health. From outside: money, image, status.
dreams.warn.extrinsic: The top dreams on your list are all "from outside". Not wrong, but worth a pause before choosing.
dreams.criteria.help: Write them in your own words. One is always there: "how I feel when I think of this dream".
dreams.criteria.fixed: How I feel when I think of this dream
dreams.empty: The list is empty. Start with a childhood dream.
book.title: Dream Book
book.intro: Printable sheets. Pick one or print everything. A4 or Letter, black and white.
book.sheet.soon: The next sheets come with the next modules.
friend.title: Dream Friend section
friend.hidden: This section appears when the device role is Dream Friend or Both.
friend.notes: My notes (kept apart from Dreamer data)
settings.title: Settings
settings.import.err: The file could not be read.
settings.danger: Delete all data on this device
settings.danger.confirm: Sure? Export first if you want to keep anything.
settings.privacy: Nothing leaves this device. Export is the only way data goes out, and you do it.
